# Chimera II OS — Crypto AI and Scanner Integration

The crypto research subsystem is divided into four layers:

1. **Observation** — read-only blockchain RPC/explorer adapters for public addresses and balances.
2. **Storage** — normalized address, balance, transaction and experiment records.
3. **AI** — CNN/RNN/GRU models for public numerical datasets and offline reinforcement-learning environments.
4. **Conformance** — C8192/R8192 cryptographic workloads and deterministic vectors.

Ethereum balance observation follows the standard JSON-RPC `eth_getBalance` interface. Bitcoin integrations can use Bitcoin Core RPC balance methods. Provider endpoints and credentials remain configuration, not source code.

The Python layer is the reference research/visualization implementation. Koronos/C8192/R8192 can later consume deterministic vectors and benchmark traces generated by Python.

## Security

The operating-system integration must not provide address-to-private-key recovery, seed guessing, credential harvesting or unauthorized wallet access. Operator-owned keys are represented by secure external-vault references or non-secret fingerprints.

## AI policy

Training and reinforcement learning are offline by default. No exchange execution or fund movement is part of the research API. Each experiment records model version, feature schema, random seed, dataset identifier and evaluation period.
